name: India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd
tagline: Affordable-housing NBFC still executing well operationally (24% AUM growth, ROE up to 17.5%, improving spreads) - but a fresh finding this pass, an escalating promoter/PE-fund share pledge (96.96% -> 100%) that directly conflicts with a formal 'no encumbrance' declaration, is a real governance flag the prior pass under-weighted.
business_overview: India Shelter Finance is a housing-finance NBFC focused on affordable home loans and loans-against-property for self-employed, low/middle-income borrowers with no formal income proof, operating ~260 branches across 15 states with a Tier 2/3-city emphasis. Listed Dec-2023; 'promoter' group is dominated by PE-fund entities (Aravali Investment Holdings ~26.34%, WestBridge-affiliated) rather than an operating family promoter - 16 promoter-group members were reclassified to the public category in May 2026.
fundamentals_table: 17.5% in Q1 FY27, up 30bps YoY (was 17.0% FY26 basis)
12.8% (screener basis, not independently re-derived this pass)
37.60%; Q1 FY27 AUM growth 24% YoY (Rs 11,284cr), within mgmt's 25-30% FY27 guide
Spread ~6.6% stable; CoF down 40bps YoY to 8.2% (Q1FY27)
fundamentals_narrative: This pass's fresh Q1 FY27 primary-document read corrects the prior pass's overly bearish framing in two ways: (1) AUM growth of 24% YoY (Rs 11,284cr) is in line with, not materially below, management's own 25-30% FY27 guidance, and disbursements on a bank-clearance basis (the cleaner comparison, since reported disbursements were depressed by a one-time cheque-realization accounting change) were actually up 36-37% YoY; (2) PAT grew 20-23% YoY to Rs 143cr and ROE improved to 17.5% (+30bps YoY) with spreads stable at 6.6% and cost of funds down 40bps to 8.2% - the opposite of a company whose fundamentals are deteriorating. Gross Stage-3 (formal NPA) is still low at 1.5% (up only 30bps YoY, management attributes it to seasonality); credit cost held at 50bps, within the 40-50bps guided range. The genuine watch-item is a separate, softer leading indicator - 30+ days-past-due at 5.2%, a post-listing high per a trusted ValuePickr thread post (cdas3317, Aug-2026) - worth one more clean quarter to confirm it isn't an early warning. The more material new finding this pass is on the shareholding side: third-party pledge trackers show promoter-group pledge at 96.96% as of 30-Mar-2026 rising to 100% by Jul/Sep-2026, which directly conflicts with promoter Anil Mehta's formal declaration of 'no encumbrances' for FY2026 filed under SEBI norms. Since the registered 'promoter' group is now dominated by Aravali Investment Holdings/WestBridge (a PE-fund entity, not a classic family promoter, after 16 promoter-group members were reclassified to public in May-2026), this could reflect fund-level financing rather than personal financial distress - but the direct conflict between a formal zero-encumbrance certification and consistent third-party pledge data is an unresolved governance/data-integrity flag that was not fully reflected in the prior pass.
sentiment_summary: Read the full thread (9 posts, Aug 2025-Aug 2026, single batch — thread is small). A detailed initiating fundamental-analysis post from a trusted user (cdas3317) in Aug 2025 was followed by muted activity until Aug 2026, when two posts flagged a real deterioration: 30+ days-past-due at the highest level since listing (5.2%), rising GNPA/NNPA, AUM growth slowing to sub-25%, and a one-time accounting change (recognizing disbursements on cheque realization rather than handover) that shifted some disbursement recognition across quarters. This pass's fresh company results/concall read (Q1FY27, reported 6-Aug-2026) shows the AUM/asset-quality picture is less negative than the prior pass's narrative suggested - GNPA is still low (1.5%) and growth/profitability actually improved QoQ and YoY - but surfaces a new, more specific promoter-pledge escalation (96.96% -> 100%) conflicting with a formal no-encumbrance declaration.
community_signal: Trusted user cdas3317 (elevated tier) opened the thread with a detailed fundamentals/moat writeup and a management-guidance tracker, and separately flagged as 'risky and worrying' the ~97% promoter-share-pledge figure cited from Screener — though a later poster (Agni, not trusted) said they checked NSE/Tijori directly and found no pledge on record, an unresolved discrepancy. Independently corroborated this pass via web search: multiple third-party pledge trackers (not VP-forum sourced) show the pledge rising to 100% of promoter holding by Jul/Sep-2026, sharpening the concern cdas3317 originally flagged rather than resolving it.

Published a management-guidance tracker showing spreads and credit costs roughly on track through Q1FY26, a constructive but measured (not high-conviction) initiating view.

bse_notes: Not independently checked via BSE/NSE filings directly this pass (web-search-sourced corroboration only, per research budget); third-party pledge trackers (marketsmojo, trendlyne) consistently show promoter-group pledge at 96.96% (Mar-2026) rising to 100% (Jul/Sep-2026), conflicting with a formal SEBI-filed 'no encumbrance' declaration for FY2026 - recommend a direct exchange-filing check before this affects position sizing.
bull_case: Q1 FY27 shows real execution strength, not deterioration: AUM +24% YoY (within the 25-30% FY27 guide), PAT +20-23% YoY to Rs 143cr, ROE up to 17.5% (+30bps YoY)
Spreads stable at 6.6% while cost of funds fell 40bps YoY to 8.2% - genuine, structural underwriting/funding-cost improvement, not a cyclical rate windfall
Gross Stage-3 (formal NPA) still low at 1.5%; credit cost held at the guided 40-50bps (50bps in Q1FY27)
Detailed underwriting processes (field visits, digital income-assessment tech) for a no-formal-income-proof borrower base in an underserved Tier2/3 niche, at a reasonable ~14-15x trailing P/E
Management guidance track record looks reliable this quarter: AUM growth, credit cost and spread/CoF guidance were all roughly met
bear_case: NEW this pass: third-party pledge trackers show promoter-group share pledge escalating from 96.96% (Mar-2026) to 100% (Jul/Sep-2026) - directly conflicting with a formal 'no encumbrance' declaration by promoter Anil Mehta for FY2026. An unresolved conflict between a formal certification and consistent third-party data is itself a governance/data-integrity red flag, independent of whether the pledge is personal financial distress or PE-fund-level financing

16 promoter-group members were reclassified to public category in May-2026, shrinking the registered promoter group mainly to Aravali Investment Holdings/WestBridge (a PE fund) - promoter_pct trending down at the same time pledge_pct is trending up (the classic concurrent-red-flag pattern)

30+ days-past-due at 5.2%, a post-listing high (trusted VP thread, Aug-2026) - a softer leading indicator than Gross Stage-3 but worth a clean quarter or two to confirm it isn't an early-warning trend
A one-time change in disbursement-recognition methodology (cheque realization vs. handover) makes recent quarterly reported-disbursement comparisons noisier
This is a mature, already-listed NBFC growing AUM at 24-30%, not an early-stage compounder - a 10x/100x thesis is a stretch versus 'a solid quality holding with an unresolved governance question'
verdict_headline: Operating fundamentals are actually healthier than the prior pass suggested (24% AUM growth in-line with guidance, ROE up to 17.5%, improving spreads), but a newly-corroborated, escalating promoter/PE-fund share pledge (96.96% -> 100%) that conflicts with a formal no-encumbrance declaration is a HIGH CAUTION governance flag that caps conviction until it is resolved.
verdict_reasoning: Correcting the prior pass: Q1FY27 AUM growth (24% YoY) is within management's own 25-30% FY27 guide, not a material deceleration, and PAT/ROE/spreads all improved YoY - the 'opposite of a hidden inflection pattern' framing from the prior pass overstated the softening

The genuinely new and more serious finding this pass is on the shareholding side: promoter-group pledge escalating to 100% (from 96.96% in Mar-2026) while the registered promoter group itself shrank via a May-2026 reclassification of 16 members to public - a concurrent rising-pledge/falling-promoter-holding pattern that directly conflicts with a formal SEBI 'no encumbrance' declaration for the same FY

Per the project's red-flag rules, this is set to HIGH CAUTION (not AVOID/EXCLUDE, since it is an unresolved data conflict rather than a confirmed distress event) - conviction capped at Low-Medium and the concern named explicitly pending direct exchange-filing verification

At 20-25%+ AUM growth and 17.5% ROE, even absent the pledge question this reads as a good-quality NBFC holding rather than a 10x-in-2-3-years or 100x-in-10-years candidate - thesis_fit stays 'neither'
red_flag_reason: Promoter-group share pledge reported by consistent third-party trackers (marketsmojo, trendlyne) at 96.96% as of 30-Mar-2026, rising to 100% by Jul/Sep-2026 - directly conflicting with promoter Anil Mehta's formal declaration of 'no encumbrances, direct or indirect' on the company's shares during FY2026 (the year in which the pledge trackers already showed 96.96%). Concurrent with a May-2026 reclassification of 16 promoter-group members to the public category (shrinking the registered promoter group). Not escalated to AVOID/EXCLUDE because it is an unresolved data conflict, not a confirmed distress/fraud event, and the dominant remaining 'promoter' (Aravali Investment Holdings/WestBridge) is a PE-fund entity rather than a classic family promoter - but it needs a direct exchange-filing check before it should be dismissed.

four_box.note: Underserved affordable-housing-finance niche with detailed underwriting (field visits, digital income-assessment) for no-formal-income-proof borrowers is a real structural tailwind and moat; Q1FY27 fresh read shows growth/profitability actually holding up well (24% AUM growth, ROE 17.5%) - better than the prior pass's framing - but at 20-25%+ AUM growth as an already-profitable, already-listed mid-cap NBFC, there isn't the headroom for a 10x-in-2-3-years or 100x-in-10-years outcome (tam=no); 14-15x P/E is reasonable (valuation=yes). The escalating promoter-pledge conflict is a separate HIGH CAUTION governance flag, not folded into the box score.
